name: imgui-colorswatch
description: Inline color swatches and a live color picker for ImGui ImVec4(...) literals in C/C++ source files.

imvec4Color.showInlineSwatch.description: Show an inline color swatch next to detected ImVec4(...) literals. When disabled, detection still runs but no swatch is rendered.

enumDescriptions: Keep whatever numeric style (0.0-1.0 floats or 0-255 ints) the original literal used.
Always rewrite edited literals as 0.0-1.0 floats (e.g. 0.50f).
Always rewrite edited literals as 0-255 integers.
imvec4Color.updateFormat.description: Numeric format to use when the color picker writes a value back into an ImVec4 literal.

imvec4Color.showAlpha.description: Include the alpha (w) component in the swatch and color picker. When disabled, swatches are rendered fully opaque and alpha is left untouched on edit.

imvec4Color.showCheckeredTransparency.description: Show a checkered background behind swatches with alpha < 1 so transparency is visible (uses VS Code's native color swatch, which already does this).

imvec4Color.detectRanges.description: Glob patterns for files in which ImVec4 literals should be detected.
